title: Pulley blank with lightening holes
prompt: V-groove pulley blank: Ø60 mm, 12 mm thick, centred on the origin on Z = 0, with a symmetric 90° V-groove around the rim that is 4 mm deep at the bottom (groove bottom at R26, halfway up). An Ø8 bore through the centre, and six Ø10 lightening holes through it on a Ø36 circle, the first one on +X.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Six Ø10 holes on a Ø36 circle, the first on +X
One Ø8 bore on the axis
The groove's two 45° flanks are cones

notes: The groove profile is a right isosceles triangle with its apex at R26 (4 mm deep from the Ø60 rim); the part of it inside the disc (R26–R30, 16 mm²) at mean radius 28.667 removes 2881.9 mm³.
